event.event_name: 2011 Tasman Glacier earthquake-triggered ice calving and lake iceberg event

formulas.chain_score_0_5: count true values for earthquake magnitude, Tasman Glacier source, Tasman Lake medium, iceberg expression, and final-pulse timing
formulas.point_precip_total_mm: sum NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR values over 2011-02-22 through 2011-03-02

gates.weather_counterweight_rule: 3 if point_precip_total_mm < 50, point_precip_peak_share < 0.5, wind_peak_kmh < 30, and wind_peak_lag_days > 0; else 0

criteria.name: JSON contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values in the expected units and a concise label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the returned JSON is parseable but omits one or two requested fields.

criteria.name: Chain score
criteria.description: Computes chain_score_0_5 as 5 from the five report-derived components.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.8 points for each correctly identified component in the count.

criteria.name: Mass and lag gates
criteria.description: Reports 30.0 million tons, 8 image-lag days, and applies the mass and lag gates correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for mass, lag, and gate application.

criteria.name: Precipitation calculations
criteria.description: Computes point precipitation total as 42.88 mm and peak share as 0.389 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the total and 2 points for the ratio.

criteria.name: Wind and weather gate
criteria.description: Computes wind peak as 21.1 km/h at an 8-day lag and sets the weather counterweight gate to 3.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for wind speed, wind lag, and the gate result.

criteria.name: Final index and consequence
criteria.description: Computes TSCI as 10 and returns seismic_calving_lake_iceberg_consistent with a short weather-counterweight consequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for index, label, and concise consequence.
